description: Genetic Algorithm Parameter Configurations for Experiments

experiment_4_high_mutation.name: High Mutation Rate
experiment_4_high_mutation.description: More exploration with higher mutation rate

parameter_explanation.POP_SIZE: Number of individuals in population. Larger = more diversity but slower.
parameter_explanation.GENERATIONS: Number of generations to evolve. More generations = better convergence but slower.
parameter_explanation.CROSSOVER_RATE: Probability of crossover (0.0-1.0). Higher = more combination of solutions.
parameter_explanation.MUTATION_RATE: Probability of mutation (0.0-1.0). Higher = more exploration, lower = more exploitation.
parameter_explanation.TOURNAMENT_SIZE: Number of competitors in tournament selection. Larger = more selection pressure.
parameter_explanation.ELITISM: Number of best individuals to preserve. Higher = preserve more best solutions.
